sloka: तौ निराशौ मदर्थं तु शोकसन्तापकर्शितौ ।सह सर्वर्क्षहरिभिस्त्यक्ष्यतः प्राणसंग्रहम् ।। ५.३७.५९।।।।
transliteration: tau nirāśau madarthaṁ tu śokasantāpakarśitau ।saha sarvarkṣaharibhistyakṣyataḥ prāṇasaṁgraham ।। 5.37.59।।।।

translations.english: "O strongarmed Hanuman your life and the life of the great self Rama, of his brother, and relatives of your king is dependent upon my survival.
